# Godot Engine

> > Godot Engine is a free, open-source 2D and 3D game engine with cross-platform support, GDScript scripting, and a scene-driven architecture.

Godot Engine is a comprehensive game development platform maintained by the Godot Foundation, offering tools for creating games across multiple platforms including Windows, consoles, and XR devices. The site provides documentation, community resources, asset libraries, and information about the engine's development roadmap and upcoming events.

## Getting Started

- [Godot Engine - Free and open source 2D and 3D game engine](https://godotengine.org): Godot Engine homepage: free, open-source 2D/3D game engine
- [Features – Godot Engine](https://godotengine.org/features): Godot Engine features overview: 2D/3D, GDScript, scene-driven design
- [Download for Windows – Godot Engine](https://godotengine.org/download/windows): Download Godot Engine for Windows with Vulkan/OpenGL support
- [Godot Docs – 4.6 branch — Godot Engine (stable) documentation in English](https://docs.godotengine.org): Official Godot Engine documentation and getting-started guide

## Development & Roadmap

- [Priorities – Godot Engine](https://godotengine.org/priorities): Godot Engine development roadmap, priorities, and community wishlist
- [How to contribute — Contributing to Godot](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/organization/how_to_contribute.html): Guide for contributing to Godot Engine development and community
- [Godot Engine - Blog – Godot Engine](https://godotengine.org/blog): Godot Engine blog: release notes, updates, and community news
